subject: Ledger cutover coordination: billing windows for bookings recognition
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@fleetops.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ledger cutover coordination: billing windows for bookings recognition

Elaine —

Quick note as we finalize the commercial paperwork: Finance asked me to confirm the PO timing and invoice milestone that will allow us to book revenue for the September cutover. To avoid a last-minute recognition gap we want to align on three concrete items ASAP:

- Confirm expected PO issuance date (legal + procurement signature).
- Confirm whether FleetOps will accept a partial invoice (e.g., 60% upfront / 40% on go-live) or needs a single full invoice.
- Identify the billing contact and preferred invoice recipient email (to ensure invoicing flows immediately to AP).

I attached a short PO template for your procurement team to use — happy to accept your PO in your format as well. If you can confirm by EOD Tue (9/1) we can target an invoice issue date of 9/10 which keeps the Sept month recognition intact.

Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@fleetops.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: FleetOps Procurement <procurement@fleetops.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledger cutover coordination: billing windows for bookings recognition

Alex, thanks for the clear ask. Procurement is scoped to take ~10 business days to route this internally; current estimate is that we will have an approved PO by 2026-09-08.

A couple of notes from our side:
- FleetOps is generally fine with staged billing for platform projects, provided the SOW splits are documented and acceptance criteria are clear. A 60/40 split (60% upfront, 40% on go-live) is likely acceptable, pending legal sign-off.
- Billing contact will be AP team (finance@fleetops.com). Please send invoices to that address and cc procurement.

I can push to accelerate but want to be realistic — PO by 9/8 is our working assumption. If you need an earlier invoice to hit recognition cutoffs, we need to understand what documentation Redwood needs to treat a partial invoice as billable.

Thanks,
Elaine
Director of Finance, FleetOps
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@fleetops.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledger cutover coordination: billing windows for bookings recognition

Looping in finance details so we have a clean handoff. Short answer on recognition rules and what we need for partial invoicing: 

- Revenue recognition for bookings requires an issued invoice (or signed customer PO that references payment terms) and evidence of acceptance of deliverables if invoicing is milestone-based.
- For a staged invoice (60/40) we need: signed PO or DocuSign envelope referencing the % split OR a short SOW addendum outlining percentages, invoicing schedule, and acceptance criteria.
- Billing address & recipient: please confirm that finance@fleetops.com will receive invoices and that payment terms (Net 30) are acceptable.

Proposed plan:
1) FleetOps issues PO by 2026-09-08 (Elaine confirms).
2) Redwood issues first invoice for 60% on 2026-09-10 to finance@fleetops.com (this allows us to recognize the associated bookings in the September period).
3) Second invoice for 40% issued on go-live (TBD) following acceptance sign-off; documentation retained in the contract folder.

Ben — can you confirm the billing code we should use and whether we need an internal cost center on the invoice? Vanessa — please add a 60/40 milestone row in the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Milestones and owners:
- 2026-09-08: FleetOps to issue PO (Elaine / FleetOps Procurement).
- 2026-09-10: Redwood to issue first invoice for 60% to finance@fleetops.com (Laura / Redwood Finance will send).
- Go-live: Redwood issues remaining 40% invoice after written acceptance (Owner: Product + Customer Success).

Open items for the PO:
- FleetOps PO must reference the 60/40 billing split OR attach the SOW addendum.
- Billing code / cost center to be included on the invoice (Ben to confirm).

Links / references: HubSpot deal (RED-5372) — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RED-5372; DocuSign envelope placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/en/transactions/EnvelopeID_9a8b7c6d
